meta.scenario_name: X30 Nürnberg Hbf – Nordostpark Express - real VAG PULS data
assumptions: Each bus keeps its own driver; driver duty outside the observed window is not in the data.
A reallocated round trip must bring the bus back to Hbf before its next scheduled departure.
X30 one-way 18 min, 5 min turnaround at Nordostpark, 2 min to change destination.
Counter-peak trips (Nordostpark -> Hbf) weighted 0.25 of peak direction.
X30 target: a departure at least every 30 min, never closer than 10 min.
Demand weights are structural proxies, not measured passenger OD counts.
validation_required: passenger impact of any replaced trip
meta.input_source: VAG PULS API (morning departures, Fahrtverlauf, verified return legs) + VGN GTFS
meta.solver: Google OR-Tools CP-SAT 9.15.6755 (0-1 integer linear program)
